course.title: Complex Variable, Vector Analysis and Statistics
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: When three fair coins are flipped, let the random variable x be defined as 3 times the number of the upper face of the head minus 7. Now, express the probability distribution of the random variable x corresponding to these flipped coins. Subsequently, determine the mean. Additionally, calculate the probability P(x < 1) and identify the actual number of heads for the values of x < 1.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2024
